title: "Creation without a creator": Pathologic 3's devs have refused to patch an invisible apple tree, and for a blissful moment, I thought they were lying to poison Google's AI
description: Magnificent, depressing plague colony fable Pathologic 3 has received a sizeable game update that adds some new difficulty modes, a photo feature, and some new, worryingly folkloric methods of defeating a murky embodiment of disease. Developers Ice Pick Lodge have also staunchly refused to remove an invisible apple tree, describing this apparently "famous" bug as a hallmark of a game whose "symbolic nature has almost overtaken its function as a product". This appears to be the last major update for Pathologic 3, so that invisible apple tree is staying in the game forever. I confess, when I first read the Steam blog in question, I doubted. The thing about invisible apple trees is that they are quite easy to confuse with apple trees that are simply not there. Pathologic in general is a house of lies: as Quintin Smith (RPS in peace) put it in his legendary Butchering Pathologic trilogy, "absolutely everybody has an angle, everyone's bending the truth and trying to twist you round their fingers." Pathologic 3 especially is a purgatorial time travel story that must be continually rewritten, a crock of festering rumours enclosed by an enormous, phantom theatre. As such, I read Ice-Pick's typically professorial account of the "invisible apple tree" with intense suspicion. Read more

title: Remember That Time BioWare Made A Sonic The Hedgehog RPG?
description: Over the three decades of its existence, BioWare rightfully earned the reputation of a legendary role-playing game studio. The news of its closing understandably has fans in mourning, and we’re left reminiscing about game franchises like Knights of the Old Republic, Mass Effect, and Dragon Age. But every studio has at least one oddity within its gameography, and the clear outlier for BioWare has to be Sonic Chronicles: The Dark Brotherhood. The 2008 Nintendo DS game is BioWare’s first--and only--handheld game. While the studio was no stranger to working with other IPs after making a Star Wars game, the upbeat and colorful world of Sonic, Tails, Knuckles, et al. is a far cry from what those storytellers were used to. And it wasn’t some small, side project for BioWare; the studio assembled a team of 30 developers, led by director Mark Darrah, who also directed the first two Dragon Age games, and writer Jay Turner, who wrote for Mass Effect 2 and 3. Storywise, The Dark Brotherhood was a bit more complex than what Sonic the Hedgehog was used to, though noticeably simpler than usual BioWare fare. It’s a plot that involves a tribe of echidnas from an alternate dimension, introducing new, otherworldly characters and concepts. It’s a serviceable addition to Sonic canon (well, it was ), and it should be no surprise that BioWare was able to come up with sharp dialogue for the Sonic characters we’re all familiar with. Living up to the promise of a Sonic RPG, you, well, played the role of Sonic. Conversations had multiple dialogue options for the blue hedgehog, with choices allowing your Sonic to be compassionate, inquisitive, or straight-up rude. While your choices might have affected the direction of the conversation, added romantic tension with Amy Rose, or even skipped some battles, this was still no Mass Effect, and your decisions didn’t cause any ripple effects on the plot. The game itself took advantage of the DS’s capabilities, with overworld navigation happening on…

title: You Can Make Your WoW: Forever Character Now And Be Ready For Launch
description: World of Warcraft: Forever's character creation and name reservations are now live, letting you save some time on launch day by making your characters now rather than on launch day. To access name reservations, you'll need to have Forever preinstalled on Battle.net and have purchased at least the $30 Skyborne Heroic Pack, which grants access to the game's new optional playable race, the Skyborne elves. Once you've done that, you can simply log into the game, select the ruleset you want to play on, and create your characters. You can create and name up to three characters ahead of launch day. Unlike in other versions of developer Blizzard's MMORPG, Forever requires both a first name and last name for characters, giving you more options and creative freedom when it comes to names. When making a character, make sure you create them on the server ruleset you intend to play on. Once the game is live, Blizzard said there won't be a way to transfer characters to different rulesets. It's also worth noting that on player vs. player rulesets, you will only be able to create characters of a single faction on that specific ruleset, so make your choice of Alliance or Horde wisely. One might think with the game's beta over and around a week to go until Forever's release that Blizzard is slowing down its communication. Instead, Blizzard is releasing all kinds of Forever news and updates, including major changes to racial abilities, promises to improve its controversial layering system, and the last-minute addition of another server option. In case you weren't excited enough, Blizzard additionally just dropped a Forever PvP-focused animated music video to hype you up even more. The trailer shows a battle between the Horde and Alliance amidst a nu-metal soundtrack performed by vocalists Amy Lee, Poppy, and Courtney LaPlante. Forever launches November 4 on PC and for the first time in WoW history will be fully playable on a controller.

title: From Cryptids To Carinderias, Here Are 8 Games To Celebrate Filipino American History Month
description: The Philippines is far from the first country you think of when it comes to the video game industry, but it’s quietly evolved into a budding hub for game development. The island nation initially had a tenuous relationship with the medium, as for a brief period of time in the 1980s, video games were banned in the country. Now, the Philippines has a reputation for its thriving esports scene, and the output of quality Filipino-made games is gradually rising. To observe Filipino American History Month, we’re looking at several recent games made in the Philippines, many of which include distinctly Filipino cultural elements showcased for players around the world. From explorations of Manila-inspired urban areas to bouts with terrifying aswang creatures from Filipino mythology, these are some of our favorites coming out of the motherland. Until Then Until Then has been one of the best-known Philippine video games since its release in 2024. Mark Borja is just another high schooler in Manila, Philippines, until supernatural happenings upend his ordinary life. Despite these extraordinary circumstances, Until Then brings me back to my own high school days with its lighthearted antics and passionate friendships, and its magical realism feels straight out of an anime. As an interactive visual novel, Until Then shares DNA with coming-of-age narrative adventures like A Space for the Unbound and Night in the Woods, though it sets itself apart with its distinct characters and Manila setting, which adds a particular flavor to the story. It also features plenty of novel interactive elements, as in between meaningful dialogue moments, you surf social media, stab fish balls at the local snack stand, run through hallways, and so on. You may need to play a couple of times before you piece together the full story, but it’s well worth it for the entertainment along the way. If you finish the full game, you can also try the recently released Until Then: Afterimages DLC. - Jess Reyes Lutong…

title: GTA 6 Developers Are About To Do Something Historic
description: Workers at GTA 6 developer Rockstar will soon get to vote on recognizing a union. The union, IWGB Union at Rockstar, is for Rockstar's UK-based developers. Rockstar North, based in Edinburgh, Scotland, is one of Rockstar's biggest outfits in the UK, and the lead developer on GTA 6. The negotiating process between the union and Rockstar management took months, and the union, if recognized, would give workers a stronger seat at the table for key issues like pay and bonuses, overtime, generative AI policies, work-from-home setups, and situations involving layoffs. The IWGB Rockstar Game Workers Union would become the largest in the UK video game sector, if it's voted in. The voting period--November 12-26--overlaps with the release of GTA 6 on November 19. At the same time, an employment tribunal over claims that Rockstar fired developers for trying to form a union is coming to a close, with final arguments set for November 17 and November 18. More than 30 IWGB members were let go from Rockstar in the UK in October 2025, with the union saying Rockstar fired them for trying to form a union. Rockstar, for its part, said the staffers were dismissed for leaking key details about Rockstar's upcoming games. IWGB said the Rockstar case for unionization is an especially important one in the UK because the profile of Rockstar North--the developer of what is expected to be the biggest game of all time--could lead to a more widespread unionization push across gaming. Rockstar publishing boss Jennifer Kolbe told Bloomberg recently, "We go where the team goes. So if they want a union, they will have a union.” Rockstar Game Workers Union Committee member Shanti Easton-Steel said the studio has "the chance to making gaming history" with the upcoming unionization vote and the tribunal decision. "As all our hard work, skill and creativity are experienced by GTA 6 players for the first time, our voices will now be heard for the first time too," Easton-Steel said. "When management…

title: This Company Is Paying You To Play GTA 6, But It’s A Long Shot
description: A company, Virgin Media, has announced a promotional campaign where one lucky person will get paid to play GTA 6. The promotion, which is limited to Ireland, requires people to explain in 100-200 words on this contest site why they deserve to get paid to play GTA 6. Virgin Media will then select a winner, and if that's you, Virgin Media will get you a copy of the game and your only requirement is to play it for eight hours and post a review on Instagram or TikTok, tagging Virgin Media and disclosing that it's a paid ad. Virgin Media is paying €100/hour ($111 USD), so that works out to €800 ($891 USD) for the full session. "We will buy the game, and let you split those eight hours across the week however suits," Virgin Media said. Applications close on November 15, and Virgin Media will pick the winner by random and contact them within seven days. You can visit the contest site to learn more, and see the full terms and conditions here. One thing to note is that Virgin Media will pay for the game's $100 Ultimate Edition, but you need to have a PS5 or Xbox Series X|S to play it on. GTA 6 releases on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. The game's massive file size has been revealed.

title: Official WoW: Forever AMV Will Get You Super Hyped
description: World of Warcraft: Forever is almost here, and in case players weren't already excited to return to classic Azeroth, a new animated music video highlighting the war between the Horde and the Alliance is sure to get your inner player vs. player hyped up to spill some blood for your faction. Called "Warpath," the animated trailer made in collaboration between developer Blizzard and Brunch Studio features a banger of a track performed by YouTuber turned musician Poppy, Amy Lee of Evanescence fame, and Courtney LaPlante, the lead singer of Canadian metal band Spiritbox. The name of the song itself is "End of You," and its nu-metal vibes go a long way to invoke the early 2000s era that WoW originally spawned from. The trailer shows members of the Horde (an orc Rogue, tauren Hunter, undead Paladin, troll Mage) and the Alliance (a human Warrior, gnome Warlock, dwarf Shaman, night elf Priest, and Skyborne Druid) duking it out on the slopes of Mount Hyjal, one of Forever's new zones. Each class is wearing their iconic endgame dungeon armor set and can be seen wielding more than a few recognizable weapons, like Unstoppable Force, Dal'Rend's Sacred Charge and Tribal Guardian, and others. It's not the first time Blizzard has collaborated with Brunch on an AMV. Blizzard released "A Place To Call Home" performed by Aurora earlier this year ahead of the release of modern WoW's Midnight expansion, and it was quite the walk down memory lane for longtime players. Forever's launch may be right around the corner, but Blizzard isn't slowing down when it comes to announcements and changes. Most recently, it announced one last round of racial ability changes prior to launch day and the last-minute addition of another PvP server option. It will also make major improvements to the game's controversial layering system. In an interview with GameSpot, Blizzard detailed how it's approaching Forever's endgame and what the future will hold for what will be the third major version of its enduring…

title: GTA 6 File Size Revealed, And It’s Massive
description: Ahead of the game's release in November, GTA 6' s file size has been revealed, and it is massive. PlayStation Game Size reports that the $80 standard edition will take up 210GB of storage capacity. Size details for the $100 Ultimate Edition--which includes a ton of content not in the regular version--were not made available. We also don't know the Xbox Series X|S file size, but it's likely around the same. As announced previously, preloading for GTA 6 begins on November 12, which is good news considering the game is massive in terms of its file size. People will no doubt have to delete other content to fit the game on the PS5 or Xbox Series X|S. This is double the file size of Rockstar's last game, Red Dead Redemption II. Everyone expected GTA 6's file size to be gigantic, but now there is a number behind it, and it's one that makes it among the largest games ever in terms of file size. GTA 6's map is three times bigger than Red Dead Redemption 2's, and the game is filled with lots of detail in the vein of that game's horse testicles. GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and it's expected to be the biggest game of all time. One report said the game could hit 25 million preorders by launch, generating $2 billion in revenue. GTA 6 is a strictly single-player game, but it's safe to assume that Rockstar will eventually release a new version of GTA Online. A PC edition, meanwhile, is expected in early 2027.

title: Elden Ring Movie Might Be Extremely Long, And It Could Have Twitch Integration Eventually
description: New details have come to light about A24's Elden Ring movie, including how Amazon could be involved and its beefy runtime. According to Deadline, Amazon MGM is buying up the Elden Ring movie's Pay-1 streaming rights for numerous international markets in a deal potentially worth "tens of millions of dollars." The site reported that there could be "interesting activations" on Amazon's Twitch platform as part of the deal. A Pay-1 rights deal means the company gets exclusive rights to broadcast a movie after it ends its theatrical run and comes to home video. Netflix, for example, paid Sony billions of dollars for a Pay-1 deal that includes the live-action Zelda movie. That was a global deal for many movies, though, and the report said Amazon MGM is booking an international deal specifically for the Elden Ring movie. It remains to be seen where the Elden Ring movie could stream after it wraps up in theaters. The Elden Ring movie finished filming earlier this year and Industrial Light & Magic is now working on post-production efforts ahead of the movie's March 2028 release in theaters. The film is based on From Software's game and was written and directed by Alex Garland, but the story details are being kept secret. Kit Connor is playing the lead, and the movie will apparently feature "battles between his character and impressive monsters and dragons." The script is so secretive that A24 is reportedly booking flights for its staffers to potential international rights-buyers instead of sending the script digitally to ensure an A24 staffer is in the room as the script is being read. Additionally, the report said the script is at least 180 pages, meaning the film could stretch to a mighty three hours. It was also reported that Elden Ring could become a movie franchise if the film does well, but no sequel plans are officially set yet. In addition to Connor, the Elden Ring movie will star Cailee Spaeny, Ben Whishaw, Tom Burke, Jonathan Pryce, and Nick Offerman. Finally, the…

title: Street Fighter V temporarily delisted and online functions turned off due to issues caused by last week's PHP security flaw
description: Though Street Fighter 6 has been the most popular fighting game in the world for three years running, there are still dedicated soldiers playing Street Fighter V right now.
